title: rtl-fast yosys-elaboration rebuilds Yosys cold on every workflow edit and is cancelled at 30 min: build the tool in its own cached job
body:
## Problem

`rtl-fast`'s `yosys-elaboration` job builds pinned Yosys v0.66 itself. It caches the build under a key that hashes `.github/workflows/*.yml` (`.github/ci-templates/rtl-fast.yml:153`), with `timeout-minutes: 30` (`:134-138`; workflow `:254-258`).

- Every head that edits any workflow misses that cache and rebuilds Yosys cold.
- The cold build alone takes about 16.5 min. Then the job's own work runs past its 30-minute limit, and the job is cancelled. `ci-fail-fast` then cancels every run of the head.
- A cancelled job saves no cache, so a re-run fails the same way.
- Seen at PR #788 head `847eb4dd`: job 121450772865, cold build 07:32:00-07:48:33, cancelled at 08:02:01, runs 40286249776/-788/-845/-749 cancelled. Also seen earlier at `43a25fa7` (run 38794077148). A warm run at `d385b38e` (run 40187422747) took 11.5 min and passed.
- Found by R705-1-02 (PR #788, issuecomment-6411351133).

The first dev push after #788 merges will hit it too. So hosted CI cannot go green, and the required checks cannot be restored (#784 comment 6400810252), until this is fixed.

## Decision

- Build Yosys once, in a dedicated job of `rtl-fast`, as `rtl-full` already does with its "Prepare pinned Yosys" job.
- Its cache key depends only on the pinned Yosys version, its build recipe and the runner image, never on the workflow files.
- `yosys-elaboration` `needs:` that job and restores the cached tree. It never builds Yosys itself.
- Every job stays within the owner's 30-minute hosted budget (owner, 2026-10-14). Do not raise any timeout.

## Acceptance

- `rtl-fast` gains the tool job through the generator (`scripts/ci_gate_workflows.py` or its template). No hand edit of `.github/workflows/`.
- The tool job's key excludes `.github/workflows/*.yml`. A cold tool build fits its own 30-minute job, measured on a hosted run.
- `yosys-elaboration` restores the tool and finishes in under 30 minutes on a head that edits a workflow, measured on this PR's own hosted run.
- `ci_events.py --check`/`--selftest`, every generator's check mode, `act_ci.py --selftest` and the runner contract gate pass. The act replay maps the new job.
- Also apply R705-1-01's exact wording fix at `docs/testing/TESTING.md:331` (PR #788).
